 A switch to renewable energy in Kenya and Uganda.
New biomass boilers will replace heavy fuel oil using
sustainable fuel alternatives aimed at reducing
carbon emissions by 42,000 tonnes

 New water recovery and reuse facilities for sites in
Kenya and Uganda, saving over a billion cubic litres
of water a year.

 Provision of renewable electricity via solar installation
in Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania, that will produce up
to 10% of each brewery’s indirect power
requirement. Brewery in Kisumu already installed
with solar power facilities.
